decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is a niche, long-cycle defence business with few competitors, and it has stayed on the website in both years, so it costs little to keep while its value plays out over long procurement cycles.
This second-generation general interior luminaire is a core line that fits the LED strategy, and moving from its own page to a mention is normal after launch, not a sign of failure.
The microprismatic pendant was promoted as a latest release in 2024, so management is still committing to it while its market uncertainty resolves.

The sister HMI searchlight has already been dropped, which suggests the marine searchlight range is being pruned, but this likely LED-based model remains listed and is cheap to hold as the surviving option in the range.
